title: intuition wager
observed_actions: Chooses a hand by intuitive judgment and wins the direct wager.
observed_result: Demonstrates a strong decision under uncertainty, not certain future prediction.
epistemic_limits: A single result does not establish 100% accuracy.
counterfactual_test: A contestant must guess a hidden choice using imperfect behavioral cues. Uses a fallible intuition rather than pretending to observe hidden state. Reject: Claims a supernatural sensor or never loses.

transfer.scenario: A contestant must guess a hidden choice using imperfect behavioral cues.
transfer.expected_tendency: Uses a fallible intuition rather than pretending to observe hidden state.
transfer.anti_case: Claims a supernatural sensor or never loses.
